_about: Henry Nettleship (1839-1893), Corpus Professor of Latin at Oxford: Lectures and Essays on Subjects connected with Latin Literature and Scholarship (1885) and the second series, ed. F. Haverfield (1895): Lectures and Essays on Subjects connected with Latin Literature and Scholarship (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1885); Lectures and Essays, second series, ed. F. Haverfield (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1895), raw IA OCR. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). No uids minted. Round du (2026-10-23), raw IA: Ancient Lives of Vergil (Clarendon, 1879), the Vergil primer (Classical Writers, 1879), Contributions to Latin Lexicography (Clarendon, 1889). Not taken: The Roman Satura (1878; the scan's title page does not OCR) and his revision of Conington's Persius (1893), since Conington's Persius is held.
